text: Given the connector is running, When a client sends tools/list with valid credential headers, Then the response includes exactly the 10 spaces_* tools named in the tech design's Data & API contract table, each with a first-line description <= 100 chars and full description <= 500 chars
evidence: uv run pytest tests/test_tools.py::test_tools_list_has_all_spaces_tools_with_valid_descriptions -q -> 1 passed. Also verified live: POST /mcp tools/list with headers, no prior initialize (stateless self-check), returned all 10 spaces_* tool names (see Self-test section).

text: Given a tools/call request missing one or more of X-DigitalOcean-Spaces-Access-Key, X-DigitalOcean-Spaces-Secret-Key, X-DigitalOcean-Spaces-Region, When any Spaces tool is invoked, Then the response is HTTP 401 listing exactly which header(s) are missing, and no call reaches DigitalOcean
evidence: uv run pytest tests/test_middleware.py::test_missing_credential_headers_returns_401_listing_missing_names -q -> 1 passed. Also verified live: curl POST /mcp with no headers returned HTTP 401 {"error":{"code":"not_configured","message":"Missing required header(s): X-DigitalOcean-Spaces-Access-Key, X-DigitalOcean-Spaces-Secret-Key, X-DigitalOcean-Spaces-Region","retryable":false}}.

text: Given valid credentials and a mocked S3 ListBuckets response with 3 buckets, When spaces_list_buckets is called, Then it returns the 3 buckets with name/region/created fields and the tool is annotated readOnlyHint: true
evidence: uv run pytest tests/test_tools.py::test_list_buckets_returns_all_buckets -q -> 1 passed. tools/list annotations for spaces_list_buckets: {"readOnlyHint": true} (confirmed in test_tools_list_has_all_spaces_tools_with_valid_descriptions fixture data and live tools/list dump).

text: Given valid credentials and a bucket name/region, When spaces_create_bucket is called, Then the bucket is created and its name/region are returned; Given a mocked BucketAlreadyExists error, Then the response is a structured non-500 error distinguishable from a generic failure
evidence: Review round 1 must-fix: every tool's region argument was unused (build_s3_client always used the credential header's region). Fixed in client.py (build_s3_client(creds, region) honors the per-call region, falling back to creds.region only when a tool has none) and tools.py (every region-bearing tool now passes its region through). uv run pytest tests/test_tools.py::test_create_bucket_happy_path tests/test_tools.py::test_create_bucket_duplicate_name_returns_structured_error tests/test_client.py::test_build_s3_client_uses_call_level_region_not_credential_region tests/test_client.py::test_build_s3_client_falls_back_to_credential_region_when_no_override -q -> 4 passed. test_create_bucket_happy_path now calls with region="ams3" while creds.region="nyc3" and asserts the client was built with "ams3" (previously indistinguishable because every fixture used region==creds.region). Duplicate-name case still returns {"error":{"code":"invalid_argument","retryable":false}}, not a 500/exception.

text: Given an empty bucket, When spaces_delete_bucket is called, Then the bucket is deleted; Given a mocked BucketNotEmpty error, Then the response is a structured invalid_argument error naming the bucket and instructing the agent to empty it first, not a bare 500
evidence: uv run pytest tests/test_tools.py::test_delete_bucket_happy_path tests/test_tools.py::test_delete_bucket_not_empty_returns_structured_error -q -> 2 passed. Review round 1 fix: test_delete_bucket_happy_path now calls with region="ams3" while creds.region="nyc3" and asserts build_s3_client received "ams3" (AC4/AC6-AC12 region fix). BucketNotEmpty maps to {"code":"invalid_argument","message":"Bucket 'full-bucket' is not empty; delete its objects first ..."}.

text: Given a bucket with more objects than one page, When spaces_list_objects is called with a limit and then with the returned continuation_token, Then the second call returns the next page with no key repeated across both pages; Given a prefix, Then only matching keys are returned
evidence: uv run pytest tests/test_tools.py::test_list_objects_pagination_no_duplicate_keys tests/test_tools.py::test_list_objects_prefix_filters_keys -q -> 2 passed. Review round 1 fix: test_list_objects_prefix_filters_keys now calls with region="ams3" while creds.region="nyc3" and asserts build_s3_client received "ams3". Pagination test asserts page-1 and page-2 key sets are disjoint; prefix test asserts ListObjectsV2 called with Prefix='logs/'.

text: Given an object under the size cap with a text content type, When spaces_get_object is called, Then it returns the object content as text; Given an object over the cap, Then it returns metadata only (size, content_type) plus a note to use spaces_create_presigned_url, with content: null
evidence: uv run pytest tests/test_tools.py::test_get_object_returns_inline_content_under_cap tests/test_tools.py::test_get_object_over_cap_returns_metadata_only -q -> 2 passed. Review round 1 fixes: (1) region — test_get_object_returns_inline_content_under_cap now calls with region="ams3" while creds.region="nyc3" and asserts build_s3_client received "ams3"; (2) inline cap — settings.get_inline_max_bytes lowered from 100,000 to 15,000 bytes (well under the SOP §14 20,000-character ceiling, leaving headroom for JSON-escaping overhead); test_get_object_over_cap_returns_metadata_only reads the cap from settings.get_inline_max_bytes dynamically so it still asserts the (now 15,000-byte) boundary correctly. Over-cap case asserts content is None, get_object is never called (only head_object), and note mentions spaces_create_presigned_url.

text: Given a payload under the size cap, When spaces_put_object is called, Then the object is written and is immediately visible to spaces_get_object_metadata; Given a payload over the cap, Then the request is rejected with invalid_argument before any call reaches DigitalOcean
evidence: uv run pytest tests/test_tools.py::test_put_object_happy_path_then_visible_in_metadata tests/test_tools.py::test_put_object_oversized_payload_rejected_before_upstream_call -q -> 2 passed. Review round 1 fix: test_put_object_happy_path_then_visible_in_metadata now calls both spaces_put_object and spaces_get_object_metadata with region="ams3" while creds.region="nyc3" and asserts build_s3_client received ["ams3","ams3"]. Oversized-payload test asserts fake_client.put_object is never called.

text: Given a list of keys where some exist and one does not, When spaces_delete_objects is called, Then all existing keys are deleted in one call and the response reports per-key success/failure without failing the whole batch
evidence: uv run pytest tests/test_tools.py::test_delete_objects_batch_reports_per_key_result -q -> 1 passed. Review round 1 fix: now calls with region="ams3" while creds.region="nyc3" and asserts build_s3_client received "ams3".

text: Given a source object and an existing destination bucket/key in the same region, When spaces_copy_object is called, Then the destination object exists with the source's content; Given a destination bucket that does not exist, Then the response is a structured not_found error
evidence: uv run pytest tests/test_tools.py::test_copy_object_happy_path tests/test_tools.py::test_copy_object_missing_destination_bucket_returns_not_found -q -> 2 passed. Review round 1 fix: test_copy_object_happy_path now calls with region="ams3" while creds.region="nyc3" and asserts build_s3_client received "ams3".

text: Given an existing object, When spaces_get_object_metadata is called, Then it returns size, content_type, etag, and last_modified without transferring the object body (HeadObject only, never GetObject)
evidence: uv run pytest tests/test_tools.py::test_get_object_metadata_uses_head_not_get -q -> 1 passed. Review round 1 fix: now calls with region="ams3" while creds.region="nyc3" and asserts build_s3_client received "ams3". Test also asserts fake_client.get_object.assert_not_called() and fake_client.head_object.assert_called_once().

text: Given valid credentials, When spaces_create_presigned_url is called with method get or put and an expiry, Then it returns a URL signed for that single operation valid only until the requested expiry, and the underlying HTTP client is never invoked (pure local signing, zero network calls)
evidence: uv run pytest tests/test_client.py::test_presigned_url_generation_makes_no_network_calls tests/test_client.py::test_presigned_url_honors_region_override tests/test_tools.py::test_create_presigned_url_honors_call_level_region -q -> 3 passed. Review round 1 fix: spaces_create_presigned_url declared a region argument but never passed it to generate_presigned_url (tools.py); fixed by adding region=region to that call and a region parameter to client.generate_presigned_url/build_s3_client. This tool signs locally via the real build_s3_client, not the tests.py fake_client fixture, so test_create_presigned_url_honors_call_level_region calls the tool through the MCP layer (bypassing no mocks) with region="ams3" while creds.region="nyc3" and asserts the signed URL's host is ams3.digitaloceanspaces.com, not nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com. test_presigned_url_generation_makes_no_network_calls unchanged: patches botocore.httpsession.URLLib3Session.send and asserts it is never called; resulting URL carries X-Amz-Algorithm=AWS4-HMAC-SHA256, X-Amz-Expires=900, X-Amz-Signature (SigV4, forced via Config(signature_version='s3v4')).

text: Given a mocked throttling response (SlowDown/429) with a Retry-After-equivalent, When any Spaces tool makes that call, Then the client retries with backoff honoring it within the bounded retry budget; if still throttled after retries, Then the agent sees a structured rate_limited error, not a bare timeout
evidence: uv run pytest tests/test_client.py::test_throttling_retries_with_backoff_then_rate_limited -q -> 1 passed. Mocked SlowDown with Retry-After=2 on every attempt: call_with_retry sleeps exactly [2.0, 2.0, 2.0] across 3 retries (budget), then raises SpacesError(code='rate_limited', retryable=True) after 4 total attempts.

text: Given two concurrent tools/call requests carrying two different tenants' credential headers (different access key/secret key/region triples), When both complete, Then neither response contains data retrieved using the other request's credentials, and no boto3 client instance is shared between the two in-flight requests
evidence: uv run pytest tests/test_middleware.py::test_concurrent_requests_with_different_credentials_do_not_cross_contaminate -q -> 1 passed. Two concurrent requests (asyncio.gather) with distinct access-key/region pairs each read back only their own credentials from the ContextVar after an intentional await point designed to surface interleaving; build_s3_client (client.py) always constructs a fresh boto3 client per call from the ContextVar, never a cached/module-level instance.
